people.name: Pamela Coley
bio: Hi There! Allow me to introduce myself, my name is Pamela Coley and I am a licensed Broker in both Georgia and Alabama. I absolutely love my job!  It gives me such great pleasure to work with all of our clients and customers here and abroad.  I am blessed to have the best team to work with.  Prior to obtaining my real estate license in 2002, I worked as a preschool teacher and special education assistant.  God has truly blessed me with a wonderful husband, two beautiful children that I have the pleasure of working with everyday and three rambunctious grandchildren.  Nothing brings me greater joy than spending time with my family, dog (Tucker) and two cats (Faith and Hope).

What did you want to be when you grew up?  A mom
What is your "hidden talent"? I am a triathlete and love it!
Whats on your bucket list? I would like to visit Israel

people.name: J Arthur Coley
bio: Hello, My name is J Arthur Coley (just call me J) and I am a native of Fayetteville Ga. I have been involved in the world of Real Estate since working as a loan officer and mortgage broker during my college days in the early 80’s (ouch!) My primary career for over 20 years was a criminal and civil investigator in both the public and private sector. After retiring I was licensed as a Real Estate salesperson and broker in the state of Mississippi. It was there by the grace of God that I met and partnered with my beautiful wife Pamela. Soon after we moved to Atlanta and ultimately founded All 3 Realty. I have the pleasure of working with my family and our incredible crew on a daily basis. What a gift! Whatever spare time we can squeeze in we train and participate in triathlons and similar events around the country and abroad. As for me, God and family come first. Everything else will fall in line.

What did you want to be when you grew up? A Professional Football Player 
If you could take the full day off of work, how would you spend it? Two miles off the coast, on a boat, relaxing with my wife.
What makes you laugh most? My grandchildren.

people.name: Trent Ratliff, RPM©, MPM©
bio: Whats up guys! My name Trent Ratliff, I am the President of Management and a partner here at All 3 Realty. After I graduated from The University of Georgia (Go Dawgs!) I went to work in the commercial and residential development sector. As the market changed, I used my experience to enter into Residential Property Management.  As a NARPM (National Association of Property Managers) leader, I chaired numerous national and local committees and in 2018 I was the President for the Atlanta Chapter. In my free time, I like to spend time with my beautiful wife, Ellen & our 3 adorable children and cheer on Atlanta and UGA Football !

If you had a warning label what would yours say? “Standback, I talk extremely loudly”
What was your first car? 1990 S-10 pickup. Called it the red and silver rocket. Totaled it going too fast on a dirt road. 
What makes you laugh the most? A good meme.

people.name: Kayla Nash
bio: Hey Y all! I am Kayla Nash and I am the Property Manager here at All3. I have been a licensed Realtor® since 2013. I have been with All 3 Realty since Day 1 (Pam and J are my parents). My #1 goal is to alway keep that “family” feel not only here at the office but in the relationships with our owners and residents as well. It’s most important to show others that you CARE with good customer service. I love Jesus, My wild/fun family (including my goldendoodle Teddy), Triathlon & spending time at the lake!

What did you want to be when you grew up? Most kids wanted to be a Doctor or an Astronaut. I wanted to be a cashier.
If you had to describe yourself as an animal, which one would it be? Definitely a Goldendoodle. I like to think that I am easy to get along with, happy go lucky, I have bursts of energy but then also like to lay around and do absolutely nothing. I also eat every meal like I haven’t had food in 3 days haha!
What is on your bucket list? To qualify for Kona World Championships in the Ironman Triathlon Distance!

people.name: Barb Dull
bio: I am Barb Dull and I am the Accounting Administrator & Realtor®.  After earning my Accounting Degree, I spent many years as a Corporate Staff Accountant before joining the A3R team.  I handle the Accounting of the escrow accounts and my goal is to be a good steward of the owners' funds.  In my free time, I love spending time with my family and friends and anything that involves sunshine!

If you had a warning label what would yours say? "But first.....coffee!"
If you could take the full day off of work, how would you spend it? I would love to spend the day on the beach,  in the sunshine listening to the sound of the ocean and feeling the sand between my toes.
What celebrity would you like to meet at Starbucks for a cup of coffee? Jennifer Anniston....she is beautiful and hilarious in her movies (and of course Friends) and we share the same birthday.

people.name: Brittany DeLoach
bio: Hey y’all!! My name is Brittany DeLoach. I am part of the Accounting team for All 3 Realty. I received my undergraduate degree in Accounting from Gardner-Webb University where I also played 4 years of soccer. When I’m not at work, you can find me reading, spending time with my family, or doing anything athletic and outside.

people.name: Jake Schwab
bio: Hi There, I am Jake Schwab. My role at All 3 Realty is Maintenance Manager.  I am a United States Army Veteran. On my days off I enjoy spending time with my wife & two sons and watching large amounts of soccer! Go Atlanta United!

What did you want to be when you grew up? History Teacher
What celebrity would you like to meet at Starbucks for a cup of coffee? First off I do not Starbucks, secondly, Julian Gressel
If you could eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be? Cheese steak sandwiches

people.name: Nicole Batiste
bio: Hello! I am Nicole Batiste, I am a Licensed Realtor® and Leasing Specialist at All 3 Realty. I have been licensed for 18 years and originally started in Real Estate and converted into property management in 2009. I love giving back to my community, I have volunteered with Habitat for Humanity and was a Girl Scout Troup leader. I love to travel to different countries and spending time with my family.😊

If you could eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be?  Fresh lobster with fresh veggies
If you had to describe yourself as an animal, which one would it be? Cheetah they are quick, they are pretty, they have no fear
What is your "hidden talent"? It's not really hidden if I tell it

people.name: Kamree Hudgins
bio: Hey y'all! My name is Kamree Hudgins and I serve as the Director of Communications, so if you've called our office, you've probably spoken with me. I enjoy spending time with my family, embracing life in Middle Georgia, as long as I don't have to get dirty! While retail therapy and Chick-fil-A are my go-to's for a quick refresh, I also find peace dreaming of ocean waves.

If you could only eat one type of food for the rest of my life, what would it be?   Pasta or Japanese. Give me all the carbs.
What did you want to be when you grew up? For as long as I can remember, I have always want to be a mom.
What is your favorite place in the world? I absolutely love the beach, but keep me out of the water!

people.name: Bonny Baker
bio: Hi. I am a licensed Real Estate Associate Broker and the Senior Operations Manager at All 3 Realty, licensed in both Georgia and Alabama. With over two decades of experience in the real estate industry, I bring a wealth of knowledge and leadership to the team. Since beginning my real estate career in 2004 and transitioning into property management in 2006, I have built a comprehensive background across multiple facets of the industry—including new home sales, commercial real estate, development, construction, and asset management.

Known for my strategic oversight and operational expertise, I play a critical role in ensuring All 3 Realty runs efficiently and delivers top-tier service to clients and investors alike across both states.

What is on your bucket list? Travel to Greece to learn about my paternal grandparents.
What did you want to be when you grew up? Pharmacist
What makes you laugh most? A good prank!

people.name: Morgan Rector
bio:
Hi! My name is Morgan Rector, I am the Leasing Specialist & Realtor with the All 3 Realty Alabama branch. I was born and raised in the heart of Montgomery, AL and still live here with my husband and son.
											I have grown up knowing the industry, with my parents, from building the home to interior designing it. I am now a licensed Realtor since 2021 and look forward to putting my knowledge to great use.
											In my free time, I love to be with my little family and our four dogs (yep, I said four) Walker, Puma, Freya & Yuki. I have a huge heart when it comes to animals as I worked in the animal industry for 7 years and adopted all our fur babies from there.

If you could take the full day off work, how would you spend it?   It would definitely be at the beach with my family!
If you could eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be? Either Mexican or Japanese, they are a tie so which ever you choose!
What’s on your bucket list? I have always wanted to go to Japan. Their culture, food, architect of the buildings, everything is fascinating!

people.name: Robin Maddox
bio: HI! I'm Robin Maddox, the Director of Administrative Services. I joined the All 3 Realty team in 2017. Most days you can find me surrounded by papers and on hold with a utility company. What I love most about being with this team is we work like a family. I look forward to growing with the company and am working towards obtaining my Real Estate License. On the weekends you can find me being bossed around by my two mini Aussies, playing chauffer or being ignored by my two teenagers.

What celebrity would you like to meet at Starbucks for a cup of coffee?  Maya Angelou, amazing writer with so much heart and strength. 
Whats on your bucket list? To hike to the bottom of the Grand Canyon
If you could take the full day off of work, how would you spend it? I would love a day spent on the beach, reading and enjoying  water.

people.name: Maria Chilito
bio: My name is Maria Isabel Chilito. I am 25 years old and I am from Cali, Colombia. I love to travel, play soccer, and do sudoku. I graduated from Oklahoma Christian University with a bachelor's degree in business administration and a master's degree in business administration with an emphasis on Marketing in the United States. Currently, I have three dogs named Panchita, Diomedes, and Tommy. I consider myself a family-oriented person, committed to everything I do, and passionate about helping others. I always strive to do my best, work hard, and improve myself every day.

If you could eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be? Anything with Plantains and cheese.
What did you want to be when you grew up? I always wanted to be a professional soccer player.
What celebrity would you like to meet at Starbucks for a cup of coffee? Definitely Lionel Messi Best Soccer player in the world.

people.name: Isabella Forero
bio: Hey there! I am Isabella Forero. I have a bachelor's degree in International Business from Pontificia Universidad Javeriana. During my studies, I had the opportunity to spend a semester at the Universidad de Córdoba in Spain. When I make decisions, I prioritize their impact on people and base them on values like respect, empathy, and compassion. I consider myself determined, confident, and well-organized. In my free time, I enjoy playing soccer, and spending time with my family and friends. Traveling and immersing myself in new cultures is something I'm passionate about and always eager to do.

What did you want to be when you grew up? Veterinary but I get panicked with blood
What is on your bucket list? A lot. But my top 3 is one Soccer World Cup game, travel to Iceland and Peru (Machupichu)
What makes you laugh the most? A good meme

people.name: Rob Martinez
bio:
What did you want to be when you grew up? I wanted to be a Pro wrestler.
What is your "hidden talent? I can play the Cello, and I Love Jiu Jitsu (I Compete in every Tournament I can).
If you could eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be? Picanha steak.

people.name: Anna-Katherine
bio:
Hey There Yall'! My name is Anna-Katherine. My role at All 3 Realty is Office Administrator. I am married to Jake (above ;). I also have an extra roll in managing my husband,
															Jake (above ;) )We work as a team to provide exceptional customer service to all parties through the maintenance process . In my free time, I enjoy
															spending time with my husband, my two wild boys & my dog, Harley. I am a self-proclaimed professional organizer. I love everything outdoors & have a deep love for all animals!

What did you want to be when you grew up? An equine veterinarian.
What celebrity would you like to meet at Starbucks for a cup of coffee? Jensen Ackles or Danneel Ackles!! 😍
If you could eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be? Chicken fettuccine alfredo.

people.name: Vania Salablanca
bio: Hello, my name is   Vania  Salablanca and I am from Nicaragua, the land of lakes and volcanoes. I have a bachelor's degree in Accounting and also a postgraduate degree in Finance from UNAN. I have 15 years of work experience in which I have had the opportunity to work for accounting, payroll, and tax outsourcing companies and I also have worked in the BPO industry where I used to supervise payroll processing for 3000 employees. I am committed and dedicated to what I do, trying to give my best and enjoying a lot to learn new things. On weekends I love to share time with my family, especially with my beautiful niece who is 10 months old.

If you could take a full day off work, how would you spend it? I would love to spend the day with my husband and my dog traveling to Esteli in the north of my country to enjoy the cold weather and nature.
What did you want to be when you grew up? I wanted to be a swimmer, I remember when I was 4 years old, I used to wear a swimsuit and watch on the TV the swimmer competitions.
What's on your bucket list? I would like to travel to Brazil and Egypt.

people.name: Coleman Campbell
bio: Coleman graduated from Georgia Southern University in 2025—Hail Southern! Growing up around his family's rental business gave him an early appreciation for real estate and property management. When he's not working, you'll likely find him outdoors hunting, fishing, or exploring new places. Coleman also enjoys searching for and collecting Native American artifacts, a hobby that combines his love of history and the outdoors. His idea of the perfect meal is a good burger and fries, and when it's time to relax, his comfort show is the TV series Duck Dynasty.

people.name: Jordan Adkins
bio: Hey guys! My name is Jordan Adkins and I am the Alabama Field Manager here (ROLL TIDE all the way) I’m originally from Prattville, AL and still reside there today! Being a part of this team has been nothing short of amazing since I started my journey here at ALL 3 REALTY and I hope to continue to help them as much as they’ve helped me for as long as I can!

There’s a lot of different things we all focus on as people (we all know how busy things can get) but my main focus would have to be my wife, Lindsey and my two little girls, Ryann and Emory. Music and drums are also a big part of my life ever since I was young. I also play drums for a band, The Hero and a Monster. We like to have a good ole’ time if you ever want to check us out! Well that’s a quick run down of myself, and if nothing else, just refer to me as that bearded dude.

What did you want to be when you grew up? A touring drummer and still on working that!
What makes you laugh the most? My wife and daughters!
If you had a warning label what would yours say? “Caution: Bangs on everything”

people.name: Teddy
bio: Woof! Woof! I am Teddy. Here at the All 3 Realty Georgia Branch, I am dubbed the professional office greeter. I am told often that I am a GOOD BOY (Especially by my mom, Kayla). My brother Tucker & I take our greeting jobs very seriously. I love to go for runs, chase squirrels & go for car rides.  I look forward to greeting YOU, so stop by and say hello!

What is your “hidden talent” ? I am really good at standing on my hindlegs and eating anything that my family accidently leaves on the kitchen counters (I one time scored a juicy filet!)
If you were a super-hero, what powers would you have? Definitely Invisibility, so that when my mom catches me eating her dinner again, I can just disappear before I get in trouble!
If you could eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be? BAAACCCOOONNNNNN!

people.name: Tucker
bio: Woof! Woof! I am Tucker. Here at the All 3 Realty Alabama branch, I am dubbed the professional office greeter. If you didn't know already, Teddy (above) is my brother! When we get to see each other we are a bundle of fun & chaos! My mom & dad are J & Pam Coley. I live with my two cats Faith & Hope. I love to chase squirrels at my home in Montgomery. I look forward to greeting YOU, so stop by our Alabama office and say hello!

What is your “hidden talent”?  I am really good at notifying my whole household when anyone walks within a 1 mile radius of my home. I love to greet people, animals, cars & everything that moves!
What's on your bucket list? Is there such thing as a squirrel farm? If so, I'd want to go there so I could chase squirrels all day long.
If you could eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be? Anything that is on a plate
